Both per-request paths, POST /api/v1/drafting/start_task and GET /api/v1/drafting/task_status/:task_id in server/routes/misc-inline-routes.ts (83849bfdd, P1-8 / IAM-11), take the organisation from getSecureOrgId(req) (401 when absent): the write first reads the program with organization_id = $2 (404 otherwise), and the read joins regulatory_programs p ON p.id::text = t.project_id with p.organization_id = $2.
